errorCode.80048d19.summary: A payload property has the wrong shape: the server expected a scalar, but received annotations, an object, or another non-null structure (common for lookups).
errorCode.80048d19.hint: Write lookups as "<navigationProperty>@odata.bind": "/<entityset>(<guid>)", not as a logical name or bare GUID. Options use numbers, multi-selects arrays, and booleans true/false. Navigation and logical names can differ only by case; inspect ReferencingEntityNavigationPropertyName with d365_metadata.
errorCode.80060888.summary: The request contains a property name or query option unknown to this endpoint.
errorCode.80060888.hint: Names are case-sensitive. Metadata endpoints use LogicalName; record tables use lowercase logical names; lookup values require _<field>_value. Cast derived metadata before selecting DefaultValue, Targets, or Options. The tool removes a bad name only from $select; names in $filter/$orderby fail directly. $top/$orderby/$select are not silently rewritten.
errorCode.objectMissing.summary: Object not found: no record matches the name or id.
errorCode.objectMissing.hint: Verify the environment, because custom-table availability differs, then query without a filter to prove the record exists.
errorCode.80040333.summary: Duplicate detection blocked the create because a matching record already exists.
errorCode.80040333.hint: Check the target for the same name/key, then update or explicitly use MSCRM.SuppressDuplicateDetection when appropriate.
errorCode.80044150.summary: The record changed after it was read (concurrency conflict or state change).
errorCode.80044150.hint: Read the current row again before writing; for status fields, verify the current value is still desired.
errorCode.80048423.summary: The component belongs to a managed solution and cannot be changed directly.
errorCode.80048423.hint: Change it in the source environment and import a new version; to edit here, first replace it with an unmanaged component.
errorCode.8004a0f6.summary: The operation violates the record state transition.
errorCode.8004a0f6.hint: Inspect statecode/statuscode and the business-process stage; activate/deactivate operations are legal only in specific states.
